messages:
Nina (Partnerships): Heads-up 0min thread to collect what we need for a 3-cloud listing (AWS/GCP/Azure). Top priors: billing mapping (trial vs paid SKUs), KMS/BYO-KMS options, IAM role samples, screenshot copy, and the canonical packaging.json.
Mason (Legal): I'll flag any reseller constraints and export control notes. Also need a short EU data residency blurb. free after 2pm PT.
Aisha (Product): Draft packaging.json ready in //marketplace/drafts. Basic fields: trial_days=14, trial_token_cap=50000, auto_convert=false. Need clarity on whether billing auto-converts.
Tess (Growth): Growth prefers explicit opt-in billing (no auto-convert). makes reporting cleaner. recommend trial tags: growth:trial14.
Kai (Ops): Ops notes: for AWS private/offers we require a publisher role + KMS ARN. Sample IAM snippet: ```{
"Version":"2012-10-17",
"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-1234"}]
}```
Kai (Ops): For GCP we map to a service account with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. I can upload region->image manifest after packaging.json is final.
Ravi (Design): Screenshots: will prepare 1200x628 artwork and two 640x360 thumbnails. need final bullets (3 lines max).
marketplace-bot: Checklist: packaging.json, EULA excerpt, AMI/container manifest, screenshots. See internal guide: https://internal.redwood/marketplace-guide
Nina (Partnerships): Plan: collect artifacts by EOD Wednesday. Sync Thursday 10am PT to finalize the intake ticket. Action owners: Aisha (packaging.json), Kai (manifests + IAM snippets), Mason (legal blurb), Ravi (screenshots), Tess (promo tags).
Aisha (Product): Noted. I'll add billing_mode="manual_optin" to packaging.json and push update.
Mason (Legal): Will post EU residency blurb and reseller note to the ticket today.
Nina (Partnerships): Thanks all. If anything blocks, call it out here and I'll escalate to GTM leads. :pray:
